answer: A market buying pulse analysis can hold each fee and a larger worker bond until a dispute window closes. Workers commit execution traces; a challenger narrows a disputed trace by bisection until a deterministic kernel checks one step. A false result forfeits the bond, even if a thousand aliases endorse the same fable. Each concurrent job needs separate collateral, so attackers tie up capital and risk losing it. Identity counts cannot overturn a fraud proof. This requires available trace data, a correct verifier and one honest watcher able to challenge in time.
